new_result.name: QFORM-PAIR-ANCHORED-E3-PROMOTION-v1
new_result.statement: For a literal original-coordinate cross block M=A[I,J] and physical row pair {a,b}, if K_ab=sum_r det Gram(m_a,m_b,m_r)>0, then the full ambient quadratic-plus-affine form has a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||_infinity <= 3*2^(5/6) K_ab^(-1/6).
new_result.mechanism: Exact factorization K_ab=D2*Z1; diffuse residual one-volume uses grouped projected crossing at (k,ell,d)=(2,1,3); a >1/2 residual row is promoted to a literal third hub and paid by exact-rank-three crossing.

stress_test.description: Fully dense 9x9 indefinite source-coordinate matrix with cross block 2 R V^T, R,V Parseval rank 3 frames, and same-bank +/-J/100 curvature.
stress_test.spectral_certificate: pure-cross eigenvalues +/-2 x3; same-bank perturbation op norm <=1/20, hence at least six eigenvalues have modulus >=39/20
